## Automated Tests Required (Planning)

### S3-2 Memory Fragment Interaction Prototype — Integration
**Planned test scope**:
- Interact request enters use-case path via input intent route
- Interaction orchestration flows through MemoryInteractionService
- MemoryState receives and owns reveal/collect truth transitions
- Reject/ignore behavior when fragment interaction is invalid

**Evidence expectation**:
- Focused EditMode test job output
- Result counts and failing test names if any

### S3-6 M1 Exploration-Memory Smoke Test — Integration
**Planned test scope**:
- Runtime smoke report generated from checklist
- PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL classification per item
- Blocker vs external/non-scope separation

## Manual QA Checklist (Planning)

### Core M1 Loop

- Enter M1 exploration scene/context.
- Approach a Memory Fragment trigger area.
- Confirm interaction affordance appears (prompt placeholder).
- Press Interact once.
- Confirm reveal/collect placeholder response occurs.
- Confirm runtime memory log updates with expected placeholder entry.

### Ownership Boundary Checks

- Input logs only raw Interact intent (no ownership drift).
- MemoryInteractionService orchestrates interaction use-case.
- MemoryState owns reveal/collect truth transitions.
- ScriptableObject remains static definition/config only.
- UI/VFX/Audio/Animancer remain presentation-only.
- Debug Overlay remains read-only.
- Camera does not drive interaction truth.
- CombatCore remains unchanged.

### Console Classification

- No new S3-scope Error/Exception.
- Known external/non-scope issues (e.g., HDRP/material warnings) classified separately.
- Placeholder warnings classified as non-blocking when expected.

### Dirty Asset Check

- After manual run, no unintended scene/prefab/asset dirty state.
- Any intentional dirty state must be explicitly documented.

## Smoke Test Scope (S3-6)

Required smoke items:
1. Project open/domain reload classification
2. M1 scene/bootstrap load
3. VContainer wiring
4. Interact input route
5. Fragment proximity + prompt visibility
6. Interact -> reveal/collect response
7. Runtime memory log confirmation
8. Presentation-only boundary checks (UI/VFX/Audio/Animancer)
9. Console warning/error classification
10. Known external issue classification
11. Dirty scene/prefab check
12. Overall PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL verdict

## Risks to QA Completion

| Risk | Impact on QA | Mitigation |
|------|---------------|------------|
| M1 slice expands into non-goal systems | Scope uncertainty, unverifiable ACs | Keep strict non-goals and OpenSpec boundaries |
| No focused tests for S3-2 | Reduced confidence in core truth ownership | Require focused tests before smoke closure |
| Placeholder feedback ambiguity | Manual verification disagreement | Require short capture evidence and explicit rubric |
